scripts.lint: pnpm exec prek run --all-files --stage pre-commit --skip staged-secrets --no-group validation
scripts.docs:check: pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-frontmatter.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-notes-tree.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-notes-format.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-archived-agent-notes.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-budgets.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-links.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/docs/check-language.ts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm docs:check && pnpm test
scripts.dev: pnpm exec tsx scripts/dev/cli.ts doctor --target core --scope config && turbo run dev --env-mode=strict --filter=campus-web --filter=app-api --filter=model-config --filter=execution-control --filter=agent-runtime
scripts.test:scripts: pnpm exec tsx --test scripts/ci/*.test.ts scripts/deploy/*.test.ts scripts/dev/*.test.ts scripts/docs/*.test.ts scripts/hooks/*.test.ts scripts/notices/*.test.ts scripts/release/*.test.ts scripts/release/*.test.mjs
